svg.title: ABHI, player 1. Class: lifemaxxer.
svg.desc: Abhi (Abhinav Singh), Munich. Life is a game. 2026: motorbiked solo over the Himalayas, rebuilt a house after a wildfire in the redwoods, built an FPV drone, won the Hermes Agent Hackathon Paris, 2nd at ETHGlobal Lisbon. Now going deep on robotics at TUM. pmabhi.com
svg.text: Go deep: one hard problem, real-world tech,
and very smart people to build it with.
Robots, in Munich. TUM.ai E-Lab, batch 6.

text.tspan: Motorbiked solo over the Himalayas at 4,000 m
Rebuilt a house in the redwoods after a wildfire
Farmed + cooked for 10+ in the California hills
Built a 10-inch FPV drone from scratch. It flew
Painted on a canvas headed for an SF gallery
Got a few words in with Macron at VivaTech
Y Combinator workshop + Claude Builders Cohort
SF robotics hack, first time touching hardware
TUM x HEC Paris double degree

svg.text: Lived: India, Thailand, France, UK, Germany. 30+ countries visited
